notes.title: Replikant: Major Update - GeForce NOW Integration & New AI Companions
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45270081/9ab09ceff857df55eec1b00d86ef859faa4defc5.png
MAJOR UPDATE - Cloud Gaming Support
Replikant has officially joined the GeForce NOW service. This major addition allows all players to access the full Replikant experience through cloud streaming, regardless of their local hardware capabilities.

Key Information

Full GeForce NOW integration with premium graphics settings
No additional purchase required for existing Replikant owners
Instant access across all supported GeForce NOW devices
Cloud save synchronization between platforms



System Requirements Update
With GeForce NOW support, you can now run Replikant on:

Low-spec PCs and laptops through GeForce NOW
ChromeOS devices
Mobile support coming soon.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270081/6889f7beca09ec6c0d8ed0e78b18e48cebff9dc0.jpg


New AI Companions

ELON MAXIMUS - Our latest AI companion parodies the tech mogul himself, complete with a quirky AI sidekick. Engage in conversations about space colonization, electric vehicles, and social media antics. 
AI GEEK - Dive deep into artificial intelligence discussions with our duo of AI enthusiasts. Get insights about machine learning, neural networks, and the future of AI. Includes weekly updated knowledge about the latest AI developments
HISTORY QUIZ - Challenge friends in our new 2-player history quiz mode. Features comprehensive question banks spanning ancient to modern history, competitive scoring.



Technical Notes
To access Replikant through GeForce NOW:

Launch GeForce NOW on your preferred device
Search for Replikant in your library
Select and play - no additional downloads required


For optimal performance, we recommend a stable internet connection.


— The Replikant Team

New Characters

 Santa Claus & Helpers - Share your holiday wishes, hear Christmas stories, and enjoy festive conversations with Santa and his two playful elf assistants. Watch them work together to answer your questions about the North Pole!

 Gianni Lumiere - Our passionate Italian film critic brings cinema to life with his encyclopedic knowledge and characteristic Mediterranean flair. Discuss movies, get recommendations, and explore the art of film through his experienced eyes


Additional Improvements

 Enhanced holiday environments
 Improved character interactions
 Performance optimizations
 Various bug fixes

We are bringing festive themes, enhanced features, and significant improvements:

Holiday Transformation

 Festive makeover for all environments and UI
 Holiday-themed character interactions and conversations
 Seasonal decorations and lighting effects


Major Features

 Enhanced real photos for the chats as complement to the AI generated

 Enhanced character behaviors and interactions
 More natural conversation flows


Technical Improvements

 Multiple bug fixes and stability improvements
 Performance optimizations
 Enhanced UI responsiveness
 Improved voice recognition accuracy


Coming Next Week
Stay tuned for additional updates including:

 New character releases
 Further refinements and enhancements
 Additional seasonal content


Thank you for being part of our growing community. Launch REPLIKANT Chat to experience these updates, and don't forget to share your feedback with us!
